name: theo-memory
description: Persistent, multi-tenant memory for Claude Code, backed by theo-memory. Continuous per-prompt recall, auto-remember, error-context, and MCP read/update/delete parity — all scoped to the credential's Principal (workspace, user) server-side.

THEOMEM_MEMORY_URL.title: theo-memory URL
THEOMEM_MEMORY_URL.description: Gateway or REST endpoint (e.g. https://app-dev.usetheo.dev). Through the Theo gateway also set the path prefix to /v1/memory.

THEOMEM_MEMORY_TOKEN.title: theo-memory API token
THEOMEM_MEMORY_TOKEN.description: Bearer token; the server resolves the Principal (workspace, user) from it. Empty for a local no-auth dev server.

THEOMEM_MEMORY_PATH_PREFIX.title: Path prefix (gateway)
THEOMEM_MEMORY_PATH_PREFIX.description: Set to /v1/memory when going through the Theo gateway; empty for a direct server.
